## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if any).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Refactoring (`refactor:`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`)
- [ ] Chore / Build (`chore:`)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (`npm run lint` passes)
- [ ] Existing tests pass (`npm test` passes)
- [ ] I have updated documentation / localization strings where applicable
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or keystore credentials are included in this PR
